> 📘 Know Your Endpoint
> 
> Based on the domain you use to log in to <<prodname>>, the endpoint for your API varies. See the [endpoint](doc:endpoints) section to understand which endpoint to use for your domain.

## Prerequisites

> 🚧 Event Linking
> 
> An event must be linked to a rule or flow within a service for it to perform an action on <<prodname>>.
> 
> Events can be created from under the integrations or directly from the flow start node.

## Body Parameters

The following table describes the elements in the request body:

[block:parameters]
{
  "data": {
    "h-0": "Parameter",
    "h-1": "Type",
    "h-2": "Mandatory",
    "h-3": "Description",
    "0-0": "expiry",
    "0-1": "String",
    "0-2": "No",
    "0-3": "Expiry time is in UTC format, after which no action is taken. For example,  \n  \n`{\n\"expiry\":\"2015-04-12T18:51:19.000Z\" //expiry time in utc format\n}`",
    "1-0": "notifyurl",
    "1-1": "String",
    "1-2": "No",
    "1-3": "Specifies a URL that receives notifications. This URL overrides the service's Notify URL. For example,  \n  \n`{\n\"notifyurl\":\"<Notification URL>\"\n}`",
    "2-0": "events",
    "2-1": "Array of Strings",
    "2-2": "Yes",
    "2-3": "Specifies the events in an array. The parameters are:  \n  _ **evtid**: Mandatory {String} - Specifies the event id that is generated by <<prodname>>.  \n  _ **correlationid**: Optional {String} - Specifies a unique transaction ID up to 50 bytes used by service providers to match requests with responses.  \n  \\* **parameters**: Optional {JSONObject} - Specifies the parameters block that may contain multiple name/value pairs if required to pass additional information to the event/trigger handler.  \n  \nFor example,  \n  \n\\`{  \n\"events\":[  \n    {  \n        \"evtid\":\"<Event ID>\",  \n        \"correlationid\":\"<Correlation ID>\",  \n        \"parameters\":  \n         {  \n            \"param1\":\"value1\",  \n            \"param2\":\"value2\",  \n             ...  \n         }  \n    }  \n  ]  \n  \n}\\`"
  },
  "cols": 4,
  "rows": 3,
  "align": [
    "left",
    "left",
    "left",
    "left"
  ]
}
[/block]


> 📘 
> 
> If a **mandatory** parameter is missing, then the API will execute with default values. If the default values are not defined then the API request will be rejected.  
> If an **optional **parameter is missing, then the API will execute with default values. The API request is accepted even if the default values are not defined.

```json 200 - Queued

    "response": [
        {
            "code": "1002",
            "description": "Queued"//'Queued in burst mode'returned when the request is accepted in burst mode.
            "transid": "9f2b2d79-1684-4ca5-addb-9d6d18fd9a70",
            "correlationid": "sivacharancustomevent"
        }
    ]
}
```

```json 200 - Authentication Failed
{
    "response": {
```

```json 200 - Request expired
}
```

> 📘 Note
> 
> The response can return either a single object or an array of objects, depending on the response received.

## Response Codes

<<prodname>> Event API is an asynchronous API. When you make an Event API call, <<prodname>> returns an immediate response code and description to confirm whether your request has been successfully queued or not. Here's the list of various response codes with their description.

[block:parameters]
{
  "data": {
    "h-0": "Response Code",
    "h-1": "Message",
    "h-2": "Description",
    "0-0": "1002",
    "0-1": "Queued or Queued in burst mode",
    "0-2": "Returned when the request is accepted by  <<prodname>> or Returned when the request is accepted in burst mode.",
    "1-0": "7000",
    "1-1": "Invalid JSON",
    "1-2": "Returned when an invalid JSON request is sent.",
    "2-0": "7001",
    "2-1": "Authentication failed",

    "3-0": "7002",

    "4-0": "7003",
    "4-1": "Mandatory parameter 'events' missing",
    "4-2": "Mandatory parameter 'events' missing in the Event API request",
    "5-0": "7004",
    "5-1": "This code may return different error descriptions depending on the request data. Examples include:  \n  \n\\- Invalid parameters/values  \n  \n- invalid value for param evtid\n- 'events' array shouldn't be empty",
